name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1879: The game First Found date and the board own ledger describe one event from two sides, so they have to live in the same storage scope, and the fork list is what decides that. Measured rather than assumed: neither is forked, which matches the doctrine that a grail is what he has ever found and is therefore account-wide, while what he holds stays per-profile and is forked. The guard asserts the pair rather than either value, so if the ledger is ever forked the dates follow it instead of quietly splitting from the finds they date.
